## 5. Transition policy + terminal guard

**`TicketStatusTransitionPolicy`** — `assertAllowed(current, requested)`  
Allowed edges: OPEN→IN_PROGRESS, IN_PROGRESS→RESOLVED, RESOLVED→CLOSED, OPEN→CANCELLED, IN_PROGRESS→CANCELLED.  
Terminal current → `TerminalTicketReadOnlyException`; other illegal → `InvalidTicketStatusTransitionException`.

**`TerminalTicketMutationGuard`**

- `boolean isTerminal(SupportTicketStatus)` — CLOSED/CANCELLED
- `void assertWritable(SupportTicketStatus)` — throws `TerminalTicketReadOnlyException` if terminal

## 7. Parent `@Version` when child changes

**No existing Bootcamp pattern** that bumps parent `@Version` on child save.

**Ticket rule** (`spec/rag-ingestion.md`): comment (and other searchable mutations) **must advance owning `SupportTicket` JPA `@Version`**.

Current create/update pattern:

```165:168:/home/kanika/Desktop/Bootcamp workspace/backend/src/main/java/com/tothenew/bootcamp/service/ticket/SupportTicketService.java
    private SupportTicket saveAndFlushSearchable(SupportTicket ticket) {
        try {
            return supportTicketRepositoryService.saveAndFlush(ticket);
```

For comments: mutate/save comment **and** dirty/saveAndFlush the parent ticket so `@Version` advances, then `recordSearchableChange(parent)`.

## 11. Auth: `UserAuthorizationService` for “any authenticated user”

`/home/kanika/Desktop/Bootcamp workspace/backend/src/main/java/com/tothenew/bootcamp/service/security/UserAuthorizationService.java`

| Method | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| `isUser()` / `isUser(Principal)` / `isUser(User)` | Has `RoleType.USER` (via `checkPermission` → current principal) |
| `isAdmin()`, `isHr()`, `isSpoc()`, … | Narrower roles |
| `hasRole` / `hasAnyRole` / `hasSelfOrRole` | Role helpers |
| **No** `isAuthenticated()` | Do not invent; Spring `isAuthenticated()` unused on controllers |

`checkPermission` (private): no principal → `LoggedInUserNotFoundException` → returns `false` (403).

**Recommended ticket `@PreAuthorize`:**  
`@PreAuthorize("@userAuthorizationService.isUser()")`  
— matches api-standards + existing “logged-in user” controllers; do not add ticket-specific roles.
